study: Hanselman & Borman 2013 — Success for All (Reading Wings, grades 3-5), cluster RCT, reading
delivery_evidence: SFA is a schoolwide model with a designated full-time on-site program facilitator providing 'consistent schoolwide collaboration and professional development across all grades'; teacher training/materials delivered on-site (p.239-240).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is the Gates-MacGinitie Reading Test (GMRT 4th ed.), a nationally normed standardized reading test not tailored to SFA (Methods p.240; Table 4 p.245).
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting the Success for All 'Reading Wings' program: a comprehensive curricular package with curricular supports, materials walking teachers through direct instruction/cooperative tasks, plus teacher training (p.238-240).
outcome_timing_evidence: Included primary effect sizes are the end-of-treatment grade-5 waves (Cohort 1 Year 3, Cohort 2 Year 2), measured the same school year as the final year of SFA exposure; no post-treatment delayed follow-up (Table 4 p.245).
